newsitem.title: POLAND: Floods down Polifarb W 97 net view 10 pct.
newsitem.headline: Floods down Polifarb W 97 net view 10 pct.

text.p: Polish paintmaker Polifarb Wroclaw SA has revised down its 1997 net profit forecast by 10.2 percent to 20.2 million zlotys due to flooding that hit the firm's plant earlier this month, Polifarb said on Thursday.
The company said in a statement that total losses incurred from the flooding amounted to about 11.6 million zlotys -- 3.2 million in fixed assets and 8.4 million in working capital.
But the firm, suspended from bourse trade since July 11, said it had coverage from insurer PZU SA.
"After receiving full (insurance) compensation, net profit will amount to 20.2 million zlotys, 2.3 million zlotys or 10.2 percent lower than expected," the statement said.
It said Polifarb had lowered its 1997 operating profit forecast by 11.5 percent to 33.1 million zlotys and sales by 11.8 percent to 225 million zlotys.
The statement reiterated the company's intention to resume full production in the first week of August.
